objective: Resolve what the 2026-10-23 field test left open about frozen-M7 parameter variants on the development cohort. ORDER OF WORK: (1) first measure the never-measured configurations (the knowledge briefing lists them) with `measure` purpose explore, in batches of up to 24; (2) then re-measure the best low-payload / near-CPU-neutral candidates in SEPARATE paired runs (cross-session CPU noise), choosing different candidates once one reaches the trusted replication cap (15 paired rows) -- never resubmit a capped candidate; (3) then locate the knee of the payload/CPU curve between batch 100 and 300 with the 32 KiB dictionary. Exact typed round trips; payload bytes only (no dictionary delivery or framing cost is measured). Development-only evidence: nothing here is a confirmed discovery. When no admissible step can still change a conclusion, use `stop` with a rationale.
